name: 11-post-process-strict
description: The STRICT branch of the same dispatch (prompt-converters.js:96-97): mergeMessages gets `{strict:true, placeholders:true, single:false, tools:false}`. Two leading system turns are squashed into one by the :893-900 pass, then at :944-945 the strict/placeholder splice runs because messages[1] is not a user turn -- the result is [system, user(placeholder), user], and the mid-prompt system demotion at :939-941 has nothing left to demote. This is the only route through postProcessPrompt that puts the placeholder into a message the caller can see, so it is the one that proves `placeholders:true` is wired to STRICT and not just to mergeMessages directly.
